title: Peñarol and Nacional face off in the Uruguayan derby this Sunday
seoTitle: Peñarol vs Nacional: Uruguayan Derby Preview
subtitle: The 4th round clash of the Clausura brings together two teams in search of morale and points
excerpt: Peñarol and Nacional play the Uruguayan Superclásico this Sunday, August 30, at 3:30 PM (Brasília time), at the Campeón del Siglo Stadium, with both sides.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Peñarol and Nacional meet this Sunday, August 30, at 3:30 PM (Brasília time), at the Campeón del Siglo Stadium, for the 4th round of the 2026 Clausura. The derby, known as the Uruguayan Superclásico, stands out because both teams need points to improve their position in the standings.

Peñarol's current momentum

Peñarol comes into the match with five wins and two draws in their last seven games, combining results from the Torneo Intermedio and the Clausura. The positive streak has boosted the squad's confidence, although the goalless draw against Deportivo Maldonado in the last round left coach Diego Aguirre with some doubts.

Nacional's current momentum

Nacional is going through a more unstable period, with five wins, two draws, and four losses in their last 11 matches. In the Apertura, the club finished in seventh place, far from the leader Racing, and missed the chance to play in the Torneo Intermedio final. Recently, the team was eliminated from the Copa Sudamericana and is looking for consistency in the national championship.

Probable lineups

For Peñarol, the probable formation includes the return of Mauricio Lemos, followed by Washington Aguerre, Franco Romero, Lucas Ferreira, Maximiliano Olivera; Javier Cabrera, Nicolás Fernández, Eduardo Darias, Thiago Espinosa; Leonel Jaime; Matías Arezo, and Abel Hernández, under the command of Diego Aguirre.

Nacional is expected to line up Luis Mejía, Emiliano Ancheta, Sebastián Coates, Francisco Calvo, and Tomás Viera; Gastón Martirena, Luciano Boggio, Lucas Rodríguez, Bruno Zuculini, and Tiziano Correa (Rodrigo Martínez); Maximiliano Gómez, managed by Daniel Carreño.

Expectations and market prediction

SportyTrader analysts point out that Peñarol arrives in good form, following a victory against Montevideo City Torque, and is the favorite to confirm their good moment. However, the derby tends to be balanced, and the prediction of under 2.5 goals reflects the trend of low-scoring matches.

What is at stake

For Peñarol, a victory represents an important step toward the leadership of the Uruguayan Championship. Meanwhile, Nacional sees the clash as an opportunity to turn things around after irregular results, seeking to boost their morale and table position.

Where to watch

The match will be broadcast live on betting sites that offer real-time tracking, as indicated in the analyses from both sources.

With information from Odds Scanner, SportyTrader.
